pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-brown regions with smooth to moderately sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank are larger and more irregular, while patches near the posterior and ventral margins are smaller with increased circularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative-space web with uniform pixel thickness across the mid-section. Junction nodes are clearly defined as tri-radial and tetra-radial intersections, maintaining high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical ridge, presenting a dark-brown fringe against the desaturated background.
